headline: Expanse Battle Rages as Shelf Flare-Ups Multiply
war_summary: Since the noon edition the wire has quickened in the north and east while the western passage has paused for breath. The Weathered Expanse counts forty changes in twenty-four hours, three in the last two, holdings four Warden to five Colonial about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Huntsfort, with some eleven thousand five hundred Colonial and sixteen thousand three hundred Warden casualties on the day and hourly rates still accelerating. Stlican Shelf has jumped to twenty-two changes, six in two hours, holdings now two Warden, five Colonial and two in no-man's-land about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town. The Nevish Line shows sixteen changes, three in two hours, holdings now five Warden to three Colonial about Blackcoat Way, Princefal and Blinding Stones. Callahan's Passage eases to seventeen changes with none in two hours, holdings eight Warden to two Colonial, though day casualties exceed nine thousand Colonial and ten thousand Warden. Stonecradle holds nineteen changes with none in six hours, Linn Mercy and Palantine Berm each hold seven and remain quiet, and elsewhere no base changes are reported despite continued losses and enlistments.
